title: Drosophila aconitase activity and reactivation
protocol: Sonicate mitochondria four times for 15 seconds in a Branson 450 sonicator in aconitase buffer.
Monitor the conversion of citrate into alpha-ketoglutarate at 340 nm at 25°C using isocitrate dehydrogenase in a coupled reduction reaction with NADP to NADPH.
Incubate aconitase with 2 mM dithiothreitol and 0.2 mM ferrous ammonium sulfate for 5 minutes.
Repeat the enzymatic activity assay after reactivation of aconitase.
